svg.title: One run, every check in view
svg.desc: One harness.json run: unit tests, a lockfile rule and actionlint at its pinned version pass; the secret-no-install rule fails on a job that reads a token and installs packages; zizmor is blocked with exit 2 because neither its pinned binary nor Docker is there. Every check runs, and the run exits 1 listing both stops.

g.aria-label: a job reads NPM_TOKEN and runs npm ci
every check ran; both stops are listed with their output
